Platform creates one own contact only, fields strictly limited/validated to avoid CRLF property injection, no arbitrary properties/media/URLs/imported address book. Original addFullName before addName (to avoid duplicate FN), company/title/phone/email/note and buildVCard/escapeText/fold perform encoding. No automatic sending/opening contacts/dial/mailto/query/persistence. Download VCF3 UTF8+JSON after Worker2sec/partialURL cleanup. Names are not automatically split into family/given name; full name preserved in FN and oneN component, apps may sort differently. No real phone import/all-client interoperability certification. REV is current generated timestamp, same-input byte identity not promised.
